Description: Susceptible people become infected through exposure to contaminated water.
Infectious people recover and become immune.
Infectious people contaminate the water supply by shedding bacteria.
Bacteria decay/removal in the water reservoir.

Name: beta
Description: Rate of contact with reservoir water.

Name: gamma
Description: Per capita recovery rate; reciprocal of duration of cholera infection.

Name: delta
Description: Cholera life span in the water reservoir; bacterial removal/decay rate.

Name: xi
Description: Rate of water contamination by infectious people shedding Vibrio cholerae into the water reservoir.

Name: kappa
Description: Concentration of Vibrio cholerae that yields 50% chance of infection.
